description: This file defines a Moose role for handling database schema connection in the Coocook project, including attributes for DSN and schema object, and a builder method to establish the connection.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Role::HasSchema
classes.description: A Moose role providing attributes and methods for database schema connection management within the Coocook project.

methods.name: _build__schema
methods.description: Builds and returns a connected Coocook::Schema object using the DSN attribute.
